name: Costos y Eficiencia de Infraestructura
description: Costos k8s por scope/app/namespace/cuenta valuados contra blended rates mensuales (Finout amortizado + Datadog) y servicios con costo directo por recurso. Foco: eficiencia — uso real vs reserva.

elements.text:
##### Resumen del período
Promedios diarios sobre los días seleccionados. Eficiencia = uso real ÷ costo facturado (max(reserva, uso) × rate mensual).

##### Costo diario: uso real vs reserva ociosa
La banda roja es plata facturada por reservas que nadie usó — el objetivo es achicarla.

##### Top aplicaciones por waste
Las apps donde más plata se tira por sobre-reserva. USD por día promedio del período.

##### Detalle por scope
Ordenado por waste — candidatos a right-sizing (p95 de cores usados vs reservados).

##### Servicios (costo directo por recurso)
Redis y PostgreSQL gestionados, con su costo real de la factura.

kpi-servicios.source: SELECT round(if(uniqExact(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))=0,0,sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'cost_usd'))/uniqExact(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))),1) AS svcDay FROM customers_lake.catalog_entities FINAL WHERE _deleted=0 AND entity_specification_id='e1d93e44-e3a5-42d7-af3e-fb3fd890ab03' AND JSONExtractString(data,'entity_type')='service' AND parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))>=coalesce(parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({startDate:String}),now()-INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND (parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String}) IS NULL OR parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))<=parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String})) AND ({app:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(data,'application_name'),{app:String})>0) AND ({ns:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(data,'namespace_name'),{ns:String})>0) AND ({acc:String}='' OR JSONExtractString(data,'account_name')={acc:String}) AND ({country:String}='' OR JSONExtractString(data,'country')={country:String}) AND ({cloud:String}='' OR JSONExtractString(data,'cloud')={cloud:String}) FORMAT JSON

trend-diario.source: SELECT JSONExtractString(data,'d') AS dia, round(sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'usage_usd')),1) AS uso, round(sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'cost_usd'))-sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'usage_usd')),1) AS waste FROM customers_lake.catalog_entities FINAL WHERE _deleted=0 AND entity_specification_id='e1d93e44-e3a5-42d7-af3e-fb3fd890ab03' AND JSONExtractString(data,'entity_type')='scope' AND parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))>=coalesce(parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({startDate:String}),now()-INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND (parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String}) IS NULL OR parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))<=parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String})) AND ({app:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(data,'application_name'),{app:String})>0) AND ({ns:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(data,'namespace_name'),{ns:String})>0) AND ({acc:String}='' OR JSONExtractString(data,'account_name')={acc:String}) AND ({country:String}='' OR JSONExtractString(data,'country')={country:String}) AND ({cloud:String}='' OR JSONExtractString(data,'cloud')={cloud:String}) GROUP BY dia ORDER BY dia FORMAT JSON

top-apps-waste.source: SELECT JSONExtractString(data,'application_name') AS app, round(if(uniqExact(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))=0,0,sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'cost_usd'))/uniqExact(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))),2) AS costo, round(if(uniqExact(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))=0,0,sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'usage_usd'))/uniqExact(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))),2) AS uso, round(if(uniqExact(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))=0,0,(sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'cost_usd'))-sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'usage_usd')))/uniqExact(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))),2) AS waste, round(if(sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'cost_usd'))=0,0,100*sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'usage_usd'))/sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'cost_usd'))),1) AS efic, round(if(sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'cpu_req_core_h'))=0,0,100*sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'cpu_used_core_h'))/sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'cpu_req_core_h'))),1) AS cpuPct, round(if(sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'mem_req_gb_h'))=0,0,100*sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'mem_used_gb_h'))/sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'mem_req_gb_h'))),1) AS ramPct, uniqExact(JSONExtractString(data,'entity_id')) AS scopes, round(sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'cost_usd')),0) AS costoMes FROM customers_lake.catalog_entities FINAL WHERE _deleted=0 AND entity_specification_id='e1d93e44-e3a5-42d7-af3e-fb3fd890ab03' AND JSONExtractString(data,'entity_type')='scope' AND parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))>=coalesce(parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({startDate:String}),now()-INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND (parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String}) IS NULL OR parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))<=parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String})) AND ({app:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(data,'application_name'),{app:String})>0) AND ({ns:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(data,'namespace_name'),{ns:String})>0) AND ({acc:String}='' OR JSONExtractString(data,'account_name')={acc:String}) AND ({country:String}='' OR JSONExtractString(data,'country')={country:String}) AND ({cloud:String}='' OR JSONExtractString(data,'cloud')={cloud:String}) AND JSONExtractString(data,'application_name')!='' GROUP BY app ORDER BY waste DESC LIMIT 25 FORMAT JSON

tabla-scopes.source: SELECT JSONExtractString(data,'entity_name') AS scope, JSONExtractString(data,'application_name') AS app, JSONExtractString(data,'cluster') AS cluster, round(if(uniqExact(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))=0,0,sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'cost_usd'))/uniqExact(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))),2) AS costo, round(if(uniqExact(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))=0,0,sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'usage_usd'))/uniqExact(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))),2) AS uso, round(if(sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'cost_usd'))=0,0,100*sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'usage_usd'))/sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'cost_usd'))),1) AS efic, round(if(sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'cpu_req_core_h'))=0,0,100*sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'cpu_used_core_h'))/sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'cpu_req_core_h'))),1) AS cpuPct, round(if(sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'mem_req_gb_h'))=0,0,100*sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'mem_used_gb_h'))/sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'mem_req_gb_h'))),1) AS ramPct, round(max(JSONExtractFloat(data,'cpu_p95_core')),2) AS p95Cores, round(sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'cost_usd')),0) AS costoMes FROM customers_lake.catalog_entities FINAL WHERE _deleted=0 AND entity_specification_id='e1d93e44-e3a5-42d7-af3e-fb3fd890ab03' AND JSONExtractString(data,'entity_type')='scope' AND parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))>=coalesce(parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({startDate:String}),now()-INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND (parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String}) IS NULL OR parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))<=parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String})) AND ({app:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(data,'application_name'),{app:String})>0) AND ({ns:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(data,'namespace_name'),{ns:String})>0) AND ({acc:String}='' OR JSONExtractString(data,'account_name')={acc:String}) AND ({country:String}='' OR JSONExtractString(data,'country')={country:String}) AND ({cloud:String}='' OR JSONExtractString(data,'cloud')={cloud:String}) GROUP BY scope, app, cluster HAVING costo>0 ORDER BY costo-uso DESC LIMIT 150 FORMAT JSON

filtro-cuentas.source: SELECT DISTINCT JSONExtractString(data,'account_name') AS id, JSONExtractString(data,'account_name') AS name FROM customers_lake.catalog_entities FINAL WHERE _deleted=0 AND entity_specification_id='e1d93e44-e3a5-42d7-af3e-fb3fd890ab03' AND JSONExtractString(data,'account_name')!='' ORDER BY name FORMAT JSON

round(if(uniqExact(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))=0,0,sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'usage_usd'))/uniqExact(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))),0) AS usoDay, round(if(sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'cost_usd'))=0,0,100*sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'usage_usd'))/sum(JSONExtractFloat(data,'cost_usd'))),1) AS eficiencia, FINAL WHERE _deleted=0 AND entity_specification_id='e1d93e44-e3a5-42d7-af3e-fb3fd890ab03' AND JSONExtractString(data,'entity_type')='scope' AND NULL OR parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(JSONExtractString(data,'d'))<=parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String})) AND ({app:String}='' OR ({acc:String}='' OR JSONExtractString(data,'account_name')={acc:String}) AND ({country:String}='' OR JSONExtractString(data,'country')={country:String}) AND ({cloud:String}='' OR
